title.zh: 把一块芯片，摆进一个外框
title.en: A chip inside a fixed boundary

say.zh: 在芯片设计中，处理器、存储器和接口模块需要放进一个共同的外框。
say.en: A chip brings processors, memories, and interfaces together inside one fixed boundary.

say.zh: 每块都要出现一次，留在边界内，而且不能占用同一片内部空间。
say.en: Every block must appear once, stay inside the outline, and avoid sharing interior space.

say.zh: 合法只是起点；同一组模块，既可以散着放，也可以摆得紧凑。
say.en: Legality is only the beginning; the same blocks can be scattered or packed tightly.

title.zh: 换一种写法，让搜索成为可能

say.zh: 切片树、二叉树和序列对，把坐标问题变成可以操作的编码。
say.en: Slicing trees, binary trees, and sequence pairs turn geometric layouts into encodings we can manipulate.

title.zh: 一次尝试，不是一份保证

say.zh: 模拟退火尝试新的编码，软模块则在面积不变时改变形状。
say.en: Annealing explores new encodings, while soft blocks change shape without changing their area.

say.zh: 接下来，先预测结果，再运行实验，最后用自己的代码验证原因。
say.en: Next, predict the result, try the experiment, and use your own code to explain why.

say.zh: 把外框想成一个不能伸缩的盒子，模块必须完整地放进去。
say.en: Think of the outline as a box that cannot stretch; every block has to fit inside.

title.zh: 盯住 E 的右边缘

say.zh: 现在把 E 向右移动；它从九开始，宽为二，右边缘到达十一。
say.en: Move E to the right; starting at nine with width two puts its right edge at eleven.

say.zh: 外框只到十，所以即使模块的大部分仍在里面，这个布局也越界了。
say.en: The outline ends at ten, so the layout fails even though most of E remains inside.

say.zh: 让 E 回到七，恰好贴住 C；共同边界没有面积，不算重叠。
say.en: Return E to seven, touching C; their shared boundary has no area and is not an overlap.

say.zh: 如果再向左移动一格，C 和 E 的内部会不会共享一片面积？
say.en: If E moves one more unit left, will its interior share positive area with C?

text.zh: E 从 x=7 移到 x=6，会发生什么？
text.en: Move E from x=7 to x=6. What happens?

explain.zh: C 占 x=5…7，E 改占 x=6…8；内部交叠宽 1、高 2。
explain.en: C spans x=5…7 and E spans x=6…8; the overlap is 1 wide and 2 high.

say.zh: 现在看移动后的结果；两块共享一条有宽度的区域，所以必须修复。
say.en: Now watch the move; the blocks share a region with positive width, so the layout needs repair.

say.zh: 最后别忘了名称；五个矩形并不代表五个正确的模块。
say.en: Finally, check the names; five rectangles do not necessarily mean the five required blocks.

title.zh: 轮到你：制造并修复错误
title.en: Your turn: break it, then repair it

say.zh: 进入实验，自己制造越界和重叠，再根据检查器指出的原因修复。
say.en: In the lab, create overflow and overlap yourself, then use the checker’s reasons to repair them.

title.en: Move the blocks. Keep their areas.

say.zh: 先看五块模块，它们的面积和为二十三，挪动位置不会改变这个总数。
say.en: The five block areas sum to twenty-three, and moving them does not change that total.

title.zh: 同一个外框，同一个分母

say.zh: 固定外框的面积是八十，所以外框密度始终是二十三除以八十。
say.en: The fixed outline has area eighty, so outline density remains twenty-three divided by eighty.

title.zh: 只围住实际摆放的模块

say.zh: 现在把注意力转向包围盒，也就是刚好围住所有模块的最小矩形。
say.en: Now look at the bounding box, the smallest rectangle that encloses all the placed blocks.

say.zh: 这组摆法的包围盒是九乘三，内部只有四个单位没有被模块占用。
say.en: This layout has a nine-by-three box, with just four units inside it left unoccupied.

say.zh: 如果换一种摆法，把包围盒变小，外框密度会一起提高吗？
say.en: If another layout makes the bounding box smaller, does outline density also increase?

text.zh: 压紧后，外框密度会提高吗？

explain.zh: 模块面积和和固定外框面积都没变。改变的是包围盒面积。
explain.en: Neither total block area nor fixed outline area changes. Bounding-box area changes.

title.zh: 更紧凑，但外框密度不变
title.en: Tighter, with the same outline density

say.zh: 看模块重新摆放，包围盒变成六乘四，面积二十四，内部只空一个单位。
say.en: Watch the blocks repack into a six-by-four box, area twenty-four, leaving one empty unit inside.

say.zh: 外框密度不变，而包围盒密度提高了；两个比例回答的是不同问题。
say.en: Outline density stays fixed while packing density increases; the two ratios answer different questions.

title.zh: 面积之外，还要留出空间
title.en: Area is not the whole design

say.zh: 真实芯片还要考虑连线和布线空间，所以本课只比较明确写出的面积目标。
say.en: Real chips also need connections and routing space, so this lesson compares only its stated area objective.

say.zh: 我们用字母表示模块，用 H 和 V 表示两个区域如何组合。
say.en: Letters name blocks, while H and V describe how two regions combine.

say.zh: 先把 A 压入栈，再把 D 压入栈；D 就在栈顶。
say.en: Push A, then push D; D is now on top of the stack.

say.zh: H 是水平切线，让第一个区域在下，第二个区域在上。
say.en: H names a horizontal cut, placing the first region below the second.

text.zh: A D H 组合后的宽×高？
text.en: Width × height after A D H?

explain.en: Maximum width is 3; heights add to 2+1=3.

say.zh: 组合时先弹出 D，再弹出 A；D 放在 A 上面，得到三乘三。
say.en: Pop D first, then A; place D above A to obtain a three-by-three region.

title.en: Keep combining to get nine by three

say.zh: 再用 V 依次接上 B、C 和 E，最终得到九乘三的包围盒。
say.en: Use V to add B, C, and E in order, producing a nine-by-three bounding box.

title.zh: 语法正确，几何仍可能失败

say.zh: 把第一个 H 改成 V，模块排成一行，总宽度变成十二。
say.en: Change the first H to V; the blocks form a row whose total width is twelve.

title.zh: 结构、完整性、几何分开检查

say.zh: 所以一个栈元素只是结构检查通过，不能替代名称检查和外框检查。
say.en: One stack item only passes the structural check; it cannot replace ID checks or outline checks.

say.zh: 在实验里逐个读取符号，观察栈，再试着构造另一种合法摆法。
say.en: Read the tokens one at a time in the lab, inspect the stack, and construct another legal layout.

title.en: A tree is a packing recipe

say.zh: 树给出摆放关系，轮廓线决定每块模块最终落下的高度。
say.en: The tree describes placement relationships, while the skyline determines the height where each block lands.

title.en: The root lands at the origin

say.zh: 先让根模块 A 落在原点，然后处理它的整个左子树。
say.en: First place root A at the origin, then process its entire left subtree.

say.zh: 左孩子从父模块的右边缘开始，B、C、E 依次落位，D 最后处理。
say.en: A left child starts at its parent’s right edge; B, C, and E land before D is processed.

title.zh: D 恰好落在 A 上
title.en: D happens to rest on A

say.zh: 标准树里，D 的宽度下方最高处是 A 的顶部，所以高度是二。
say.en: In the reference tree, the highest skyline under D is A’s top, so D lands at height two.

title.zh: 交换 A 与 C，先猜 D
title.en: Swap A and C. Predict D.

say.zh: 如果交换 A 和 C 的名称，D 还会停在高度二吗？
say.en: If we swap the names A and C, will D still land at height two?

text.zh: 交换后 D 的 y 是多少？
text.en: D’s y after swapping A and C?

explain.zh: D 的宽度跨过 B；B 的顶部为 3，会把 D 托高。
explain.en: D spans part of B, whose top at 3 lifts D.

title.zh: 不是父块，是整个覆盖区间

say.zh: 看交换后的布局；D 覆盖到了更高的 B，所以它被托到高度三。
say.en: Watch the swapped layout; D reaches over taller B, which lifts it to height three.

title.en: Still legal, but a larger box

say.zh: 包围盒从二十七变成三十六；合法性没有告诉我们这次交换是否更好。
say.en: The box grows from twenty-seven to thirty-six; legality alone does not say whether the swap improved it.

title.zh: 用反例检查自己的实现

say.zh: 进入实验修改树，用轮廓线解释高度，而不是只背左孩子和右孩子。
say.en: Edit the tree in the lab, and explain heights using the skyline rather than memorizing child labels.

say.zh: 序列对用两行字母记录每一对模块的相对位置。
say.en: A sequence pair uses two rows of letters to encode every pair of blocks.

say.zh: A 和 B 在两个排列中顺序相同，所以 A 在 B 左边。
say.en: A comes before B in both permutations, so A must be left of B.

say.zh: A 在第一行先于 D，在第二行后于 D；按本课约定，A 在 D 下方。
say.en: A precedes D in the first row but follows D in the second; here that means A is below D.

say.zh: D 必须越过下方所有模块，而不只是 A，所以坐标要对所有前驱取最大。
say.en: D must clear every block below it, not only A, so take the maximum over all predecessor bounds.

title.zh: 先预测：D 到底有多高？

say.zh: 其中 B 的顶部比 A 高一格；现在预测 D 的最终高度。
say.en: B’s top is one unit higher than A’s; predict the final height of D.

explain.zh: 所有竖直前驱的顶部取最大值，max(2,3,2,2)=3。
explain.en: Take the maximum top among vertical predecessors: max(2,3,2,2)=3.

title.en: Nine by four, not nine by three

say.zh: 标准序列对得到九乘四的包围盒；它与前一课的标准树不是同一份编码。
say.en: The reference pair produces a nine-by-four box; it is a different encoding from the previous lesson’s reference tree.

say.zh: 让两个排列完全相同，所有模块从左到右排开，仍然会超过外框。
say.en: Make both permutations identical; the blocks line up without overlap but extend beyond the outline.

say.zh: 在实验里更改两个排列，再用 Python 写出最长路径更新。
say.en: Change the permutations in the lab, then implement the longest-path updates in Python.

say.zh: 表示法生成布局，模拟退火则在不同编码之间搜索。
say.en: A representation generates layouts; simulated annealing searches among their encodings.

say.zh: 这里每次交换某一个排列里的两个名称，再重新解码并计算能量。
say.en: Here each proposal swaps two names in one permutation, then decodes and scores the new layout.

title.zh: 候选能量，减去当前能量

say.zh: 能量下降就接受，能量上升则不必立即拒绝。
say.en: Accept a decrease in energy; an increase does not have to be rejected immediately.

say.zh: 对于变差的候选，接受概率是负的能量差除以温度，再取指数。
say.en: For an uphill proposal, acceptance probability is the exponential of negative energy change divided by temperature.

title.en: Predict: what does higher temperature do?

say.zh: 同样一次变差，如果温度更高，它会更容易被接受吗？
say.en: For the same uphill change, does a higher temperature make acceptance more likely?

text.zh: 相同 ΔE>0，温度越高，接受概率？
text.en: For the same ΔE>0, at higher T acceptance is…

explain.zh: −ΔE/T 更接近零，所以 exp(−ΔE/T) 更大。
explain.en: −ΔE/T is closer to zero, so exp(−ΔE/T) is larger.

title.en: The current solution can get worse

say.zh: 看这次实际接受的变差候选；当前解改变，但历史最好合法解不会被覆盖。
say.en: Watch an uphill proposal that this run accepts; current changes, but a better legal incumbent is not overwritten.

title.en: On rejection, keep the current layout

say.zh: 另一份候选被拒绝，当前布局保持原样；随机数和概率共同决定这一步。
say.en: Another proposal is rejected, leaving current unchanged; the random draw and probability determine this decision.

say.zh: 最后查看这次固定种子的最好合法解；一次成功不代表每次都能得到最优。
say.en: Finally inspect the best legal layout for this fixed seed; one successful run is not an optimality guarantee.

title.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

chapter.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

say.zh: A 的面积固定为六。把它变窄，布局一定更好吗？
say.en: A has fixed area six. Does making it narrower necessarily improve the placement?

title.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

chapter.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

say.zh: 早期规划把一些逻辑区域抽象成面积固定、形状可调的矩形，这就是这里的软模块。
say.en: Early planning models some logic regions as rectangles with fixed area and adjustable shape: soft blocks.

lines.zh: 宽、高可以在约束内调整

title.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

chapter.zh: 软模块：哪些量可以改变？

say.zh: 固定尺寸的存储器宏单元不能随意拉伸；本例只有 A 能改形状。
say.en: Fixed memory macros cannot stretch arbitrarily; only A may reshape in this example.

lines.zh: 不能为了排版随意拉伸。
lines.en: Do not stretch it just to make room.

say.zh: A 的宽和高必须为正，而且乘积始终为六。
say.en: A’s width and height must be positive, and their product must remain six.

lines.en: w is width; h is height.

say.zh: 宽高比定义为宽除以高，不是高除以宽。
say.en: Aspect ratio means width divided by height, not the reverse.

say.zh: 我们要求宽高比在零点五到二之间，边界也允许。
say.en: The allowed aspect ratio is from one half to two, including both endpoints.

lines.en: Excessively tall or wide shapes fail.

say.zh: 原来的三乘二，面积为六，宽高比为一点五，因此是允许的形状。
say.en: The original three-by-two shape has area six and aspect ratio one point five, so it is allowed.

say.zh: 二乘三的面积也为六，宽高比约为零点六七，它也通过形状检查。
say.en: Two by three also has area six; its aspect ratio is about zero point six seven, within the bounds.

lines.en: Neighbors have not been checked yet.

say.zh: 在整数网格上，先列出面积六的正整数因数对。
say.en: On an integer grid, first list every positive integer factor pair of six.

say.zh: 一乘六太高，六乘一太宽；两者面积正确，却都超出了宽高比范围。
say.en: One by six is too tall; six by one is too wide, so both fail the aspect-ratio limits.

say.zh: 筛掉这两个极端形状，整数实验中只剩二乘三和三乘二。
say.en: Removing those extremes leaves two by three and three by two for this integer experiment.

say.zh: 连续模型不只允许整数；选定正的宽度后，可以用六除以宽度计算高度。
say.en: A continuous model also allows noninteger dimensions; choose a positive width and calculate height as six divided by width.

lines.zh: 动画中间帧也保持面积。
比例限制仍然需要检查。

say.zh: 坐标原点在外框左下角，向右是横坐标增加，向上是纵坐标增加。
say.en: The origin is the lower-left corner; x increases rightward and y increases upward.

say.zh: A 在原点，尺寸三乘二；D 在零、二，尺寸三乘一，正好贴住 A 上边缘。
say.en: A starts at the origin, three by two; D starts at zero, two, three by one, touching A’s top edge.

lines.zh: 只有共同边，没有重叠面积。

say.zh: 原布局合法，包围盒九乘三等于二十七，减去模块面积和二十三，盒内空余四。
say.en: The legal box is nine by three: area twenty-seven, minus block area twenty-three, leaves four empty units.

lines.zh: 刚好围住所有模块的矩形。

say.zh: 外框是十乘八，面积八十；它与包围盒不是同一个矩形。
say.en: The fixed outline is ten by eight, with area eighty; it is different from the bounding box.

lines.zh: 包围盒：当前摆放占用范围

say.zh: 现在只把 A 改成二乘三，其余模块先保持原位。
say.en: Now change only A to two by three, while leaving every other block in place.

say.zh: A 变窄之后，布局还合法吗？先看它的顶部会到哪里。
say.en: Will the placement remain legal after A narrows? First predict where its top edge will end.

text.zh: A 改为2×3，其余不动，会怎样？
text.en: A becomes 2×3; neighbors stay fixed. What happens?

options.en: Still legal because it is narrower

options.zh: 与 D 出现正面积重叠

explain.zh: 新占用区间x=0…2、y=2…3与D相交，面积2。
explain.en: The new x=0…2, y=2…3 strip intersects D with area 2.

say.zh: 看 A 的右边缘向左退，同时顶部从二升到三。
say.en: Watch A’s right edge retreat while its top rises from two to three.

lines.en: One less width unit, one more height unit.

say.zh: 新的 A 占横坐标零到二，D 占零到三，两者在横向相交。
say.en: The new A spans x from zero to two; D spans zero to three, so their horizontal intervals overlap.

say.zh: 纵向共同部分是二到三，因此交叠高度为一，重叠面积为二。
say.en: Their shared vertical interval is two to three, giving overlap height one and overlap area two.

say.zh: 两个矩形只共用边界时，交叠宽度或高度为零，因此允许贴边。
say.en: When rectangles only share a boundary, an overlap dimension is zero, so touching is allowed.

lines.zh: 面积为0的接触可以通过。

say.zh: 因此先修复冲突，确认合法之后，再比较包围盒。
say.en: Repair the conflict first; compare bounding boxes only after confirming legality.

lines.zh: 形状 → 完整 → 边界 → 重叠

title.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

chapter.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

say.zh: 先试一个局部修法：把 D 向右移动两格。
say.en: Try a local repair by moving D two grid units to the right.

title.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

chapter.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

say.zh: D 不再覆盖 A，却进入了 B 的区域，所以还没有修好。
say.en: D no longer covers A, but it now enters B’s space, so the repair is incomplete.

title.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

chapter.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

say.zh: 再把 D 上移一格，底边到三，与 B 贴边，布局恢复合法。
say.en: Move D up one unit to y equals three, touching B without overlapping A or B.

title.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

chapter.zh: 先修碰撞，不急着求最优

say.zh: 但最高处变成四，最右边仍是九，包围盒面积反而增加到三十六。
say.en: However, the top reaches four while the right edge stays nine, so bounding-box area increases to thirty-six.

lines.zh: 修好碰撞，不代表完成优化。
lines.en: Repairing a collision is not optimization.

title.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
title.en: Repack one block at a time

chapter.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
chapter.en: Repack one block at a time

say.zh: 保留 A 的二乘三形状，把 B 左移一格，贴住 A 的右边缘。
say.en: Keep A at two by three and move B left one unit until it touches A’s right edge.

title.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
title.en: Repack one block at a time

chapter.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
chapter.en: Repack one block at a time

say.zh: 接着把 C 左移一格，贴到 B 右边。
say.en: Next, move C left one unit to touch B’s right edge.

title.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
title.en: Repack one block at a time

chapter.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
chapter.en: Repack one block at a time

say.zh: 把 D 移到四、二，底边贴住 C 的顶部，左边缘贴住 B 的右边缘。
say.en: Move D to four, two: its bottom touches C, and its left edge touches B.

heading.zh: 为 D 找到较低位置
heading.en: Find a lower resting position for D

title.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
title.en: Repack one block at a time

chapter.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
chapter.en: Repack one block at a time

say.zh: 新布局再次得到九乘三，面积二十七，和原来一样。
say.en: The new placement again has a nine-by-three box with area twenty-seven, matching the baseline.

heading.zh: 变形本身没有带来收益

lines.zh: 合法，而且回到了原面积。
lines.en: Legal, with baseline box area restored.

title.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
title.en: Repack one block at a time

chapter.zh: 逐块重摆，回到原来面积
chapter.en: Repack one block at a time

say.zh: 如果还想压小包围盒，应该关注仍然伸到最右侧的哪一块？
say.en: To shrink the box further, which block still determines the rightmost edge?

lines.en: Identify which block sets the boundary.

text.en: Which block still extends the right boundary to x=9?

explain.en: E starts at (7,0) with width 2, so its right edge is 9.

title.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

chapter.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

say.zh: 先把 D 移到零、三，腾出 C 上方的空间。
say.en: First move D to zero, three, freeing the space above C.

title.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

chapter.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

say.zh: 这时包围盒暂时变大，不必把每个中间动作都当成最终结果。
say.en: The box temporarily grows at this intermediate step; do not confuse an intermediate move with the final result.

heading.zh: 中间状态不是最终答案
heading.en: An intermediate state is not the answer

lines.en: E has not entered the freed space yet.

title.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

chapter.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

say.zh: 把 E 移到四、二，贴住 C 上方和 B 右侧，同时避开 D。
say.en: Move E to four, two, above C and right of B, without covering D.

heading.en: Move E into the free space

title.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

chapter.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

say.zh: 最右边现在是六，最高处是四，所以包围盒为六乘四，面积二十四。
say.en: The rightmost edge is now six and the top is four, giving a six-by-four box with area twenty-four.

lines.en: Narrowing A alone did not achieve this.

title.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

chapter.zh: 再压紧一次，解释每次移动

say.zh: 模块面积和仍为二十三，因此合法包围盒内部只空余一个单位。
say.en: Total block area remains twenty-three, leaving only one unoccupied unit inside this legal bounding box.

title.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

chapter.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

say.zh: 外框仍为八十，所以固定外框密度仍是二十三除以八十，也就是百分之二十八点七五。
say.en: The outline stays eighty, so fixed-outline density remains twenty-three over eighty, or twenty-eight point seven five percent.

lines.zh: 外框没有跟着包围盒缩小。
lines.en: The outline does not shrink with the box.

title.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

chapter.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

say.zh: 包围盒密度换了分母，原来是二十三除以二十七，约百分之八十五点二。
say.en: Packing density uses a different denominator; the baseline is twenty-three over twenty-seven, about eighty-five point two percent.

title.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

chapter.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

say.zh: 压紧后的包围盒密度是二十三除以二十四，约百分之九十五点八。
say.en: After compaction, packing density becomes twenty-three over twenty-four, about ninety-five point eight percent.

heading.zh: 这个比例反映压紧程度

lines.zh: 同样的模块，用更小的盒。
lines.en: The same blocks occupy a smaller box.

title.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

chapter.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

say.zh: 所以报告密度时，必须同时说清楚分母是哪一个矩形。
say.en: Whenever you report a density, state which rectangle supplies the denominator.

text.zh: 这次压紧后，哪个比例提高了？

explain.zh: 面积和23、外框80不变；包围盒从27缩到24。
explain.en: Block area 23 and outline 80 stay fixed; the box shrinks from 27 to 24.

title.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

chapter.zh: 两个密度，回答两个问题

say.zh: 二十四是这里给出的一份合法见证，不代表所有软模块问题都能达到这个结果。
say.en: Twenty-four is a verified legal witness here, not a universal result for soft-block problems.

lines.zh: 没有证明连续全局最优。

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 换一个面积为八的模块，宽高比范围仍为零点五到二。
say.en: Consider a new block of area eight, with the same aspect-ratio bounds from one half to two.

heading.zh: 迁移练习，不改公共算例

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 二乘四和四乘二，哪些能通过形状检查？先分别算面积与宽高比。
say.en: Do two by four and four by two pass the shape check? Calculate both area and aspect ratio.

lines.zh: 不要把小于等于写成小于。
lines.en: Do not replace inclusive bounds with strict ones.

text.zh: 面积8、比例范围含端点，哪个形状允许？
text.en: For area 8 with inclusive ratio bounds, which shapes are allowed?

explain.zh: 两者面积都是8，宽高比分别0.5与2，正好位于允许边界。
explain.en: Both have area 8; their ratios 0.5 and 2 are the included endpoints.

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 两种形状都允许，因为面积都为八，宽高比分别落在允许范围的两个端点。
say.en: Both shapes are allowed: each has area eight, and their aspect ratios equal the two permitted endpoints.

lines.zh: 仍然必须检查放置位置。

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 回到五模块实验，保持 A 为二乘三，先消除重叠，再尝试把包围盒压到二十四。
say.en: Return to the five-block lab: keep A at two by three, repair overlaps, then try reaching box area twenty-four.

lines.en: Stage two: legal with box area ≤24.

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 代码先检查正尺寸，再检查面积误差和宽高比，最后调用布局检查。
say.en: In code, check positive dimensions, area tolerance, and aspect ratio before running the placement checks.

lines.zh: 形状检查不读取邻居坐标。
lines.en: Shape checks do not inspect neighbors.

lines.zh: 布局检查必须读取坐标。

title.en: Transfer the method to a new case

chapter.en: Transfer the method to a new case

say.zh: 记住完整过程：选形状、重摆邻居、检查合法性，最后比较明确的目标。
say.en: Keep the complete process: choose a shape, repack neighbors, check legality, and then compare the stated objective.

heading.en: You should be able to explain

lines.zh: 为什么撞、怎样修、是否变好。
lines.en: Why it collided, how to repair it, and whether it improved.
